Senior Manager - Corporate Legal and Commercial Affairs
Senior Manager Legal litigation and corporate affairs
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 Corporate Lawyer Litigation & Compliance Industry: Manufacturing / Automotive / Engineering
 Experience: 10–15 Years
 Employment Type: Full-time
 Function: Legal & Corporate Affairs
 Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu
 Employer: Leading Manufacturing Organization Role Overview We are looking for an accomplished Corporate Lawyer with 10–15 years of experience to join the legal team of a large, established manufacturing organization. The role requires a strong combination of litigation management, regulatory and statutory compliance, corporate legal advisory, and stakeholder management . The successful candidate should have substantial in-house legal experience within a manufacturing, automotive, engineering, industrial, or allied organization and be comfortable handling complex legal matters across multiple business functions and locations. Key Responsibilities Litigation Management Manage civil, commercial, consumer, labour, employment and other litigation involving the organization. Handle matters before courts, tribunals, statutory authorities and other judicial/quasi-judicial forums. Coordinate closely with external advocates, law firms and senior counsels for ongoing litigation. Prepare and review notices, replies, pleadings, affidavits, petitions and other litigation-related documentation. Track litigation matters, legal exposures, hearing dates, outcomes and action points. Develop litigation strategy in consultation with internal stakeholders and external counsel. Drive timely closure and resolution of disputes while protecting the organization's legal and commercial interests. Manage pre-litigation disputes and support negotiation, mediation and settlement wherever appropriate. Compliance & Regulatory Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations and statutory requirements relevant to manufacturing operations. Monitor changes in legislation and assess their impact on the business. Work with business functions to strengthen the organization's compliance framework. Support periodic legal and compliance audits across functions and locations. Identify compliance gaps and recommend appropriate corrective and preventive actions. Maintain appropriate compliance documentation, records and reporting mechanisms. Partner with internal stakeholders on implementation of policies, SOPs and statutory requirements. Support interactions with government departments, regulators and statutory authorities wherever required. Corporate Legal Advisory Provide practical legal advice to business teams on day-to-day operational and commercial matters. Advise management on legal risks arising from business decisions, operational issues and disputes. Review and interpret applicable legislation, regulatory requirements and contractual obligations. Support senior leadership in evaluating legal exposure and developing appropriate risk-mitigation strategies. Provide legal guidance to HR, procurement, operations, finance, sales and other business functions. Contracts & Documentation Review, draft and negotiate commercial agreements, vendor agreements, service agreements, NDAs, purchase arrangements and other business contracts. Identify contractual risks and recommend appropriate safeguards. Standardize legal clauses and documentation wherever possible. Support contractual dispute resolution and enforcement matters. Legal Governance & Risk Management Maintain dashboards/MIS for litigation, compliance and critical legal matters. Identify emerging legal and regulatory risks affecting the organization. Support development and strengthening of internal legal governance mechanisms. Ensure appropriate documentation, approvals and legal controls are maintained for material matters. Work closely with senior management on high-impact and sensitive legal issues. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate should have: 10–15 years of post-qualification legal experience. Significant experience working as an in-house legal professional in a manufacturing organization . Strong hands-on exposure to litigation and dispute management . Demonstrated experience in statutory, regulatory and corporate compliance . Good understanding of laws relevant to industrial and manufacturing organizations. Experience coordinating with external advocates, law firms, regulatory authorities and senior internal stakeholders. Strong ability to assess legal risk and translate legal requirements into practical business recommendations. Excellent drafting, negotiation, analytical and communication skills. Ability to independently manage multiple high-priority legal matters. Preferred Industry Background Candidates from the following sectors will be particularly relevant: Automotive / Auto Components Heavy Engineering Industrial Manufacturing Engineering & Capital Goods Machinery / Equipment Manufacturing Metals / Steel Chemicals Consumer Durables Electrical / Electronics Manufacturing Other large manufacturing organizations Candidates whose experience is predominantly with law firms, consulting organizations, IT/ITES, banking or financial services without meaningful manufacturing-sector exposure may not be aligned with the role. Educational Qualification LL.B. from a recognized university is mandatory. LL.M. or additional qualifications in corporate/commercial law will be an advantage. Key Competencies Litigation & Dispute Management Legal Compliance Regulatory Affairs Corporate Law Manufacturing Laws & Regulations Commercial Contracts Legal Risk Management Legal Drafting Stakeholder Management External Counsel Management Negotiation Legal Governance What We Are Looking For This opportunity will suit a legal professional who combines strong legal fundamentals with commercial judgment and is capable of operating effectively within a complex manufacturing environment. The individual should be able to independently manage litigation and compliance matters while serving as a trusted legal advisor to senior business stakeholders. 
 Preferred candidate profile

Key Skills: Arbitration,Corporate Governance,Litigation,Legal,Litigation management,Corporate affairs,Governance,Corporate

title: Senior Associate Legal / Associate Manager Legal
description:
Key Responsibilities: - 
 Draft comprehensive Title Opinions / Legal Verification Reports using the Maatrum technology platform. Conduct detailed verification and analysis of land and real estate property documents. Review property title, ownership, encumbrances, legal documents, and other relevant records. Work closely with clients to understand their credit policy and legal requirements and ensure timely delivery of reports. Address client queries and provide appropriate legal clarifications and solutions. Coordinate with the Operations and Technology teams to improve Turnaround Time (TAT), streamline workflows, and enhance platform functionality. Ensure the quality and accuracy of legal reports in line with client policies and Maatrum's internal quality standards. Identify potential legal/title issues and provide practical and proactive solutions. Support the in-house legal team in resolving complex property-related issues and queries. Ensure reports are completed within defined TAT and quality parameters. Stay updated on applicable property laws, land records, registration processes, and state-specific regulations. 
 Candidate Requirements: - 
 LLB / LLM from a recognized university. LLM from a reputed public university will be preferred. Minimum 3+ years of relevant experience in Land and Real Estate Property matters. Strong experience in Title Verification / Property Due Diligence / Legal Opinion. Candidates with experience in Banking, NBFC, Real Estate Developers, Law Firms, or Property Legal Services are preferred. Strong knowledge of land and property laws, title verification, encumbrance, registration, and property documentation. Fluency in Tamil is mandatory Read, Write and Speak. Good communication and client-handling skills. Strong analytical and documentation skills. Ability to work independently and manage multiple assignments within defined TAT. Candidates with experience in TN property/title verification will be preferred.

Key Skills: Tamil,title report,Drafting Deeds,Title Verification,Sale Deed,Non Litigation,Title Search,Property Laws
